name: 侠客行2000最新版
english_description: The Quest of Oriental Chivalry ("Xiake Xing I"), by the XiaKeXing Gaming Group, 1996-1999, MudOS v22b25 lineage, ported by sdong. Shares the same map skeleton as this project's jym (Jin Yong's Dream) — scenes such as d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc are identical in content, differing only in the "cracker" credit header ("Cracked by Kafei" here versus "Cracked by Roath" for jym/xkm) — evidently different circulating copies of the same underlying codebase. Its map covers classic sect landmarks like Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, the Murong clan, and Zhongnan, plus geographic settings such as Dongting Lake, Lake Tai, Huangshan, and the Western Xia region; registration opens with a GB/BIG5 encoding choice, typical of these older cross-strait shared designs.
